text:
Situation: Heparin sodium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2017-11-14 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Our inventory across three sites ranges from 5.9 to 31.7 days of supply, with Corvale East showing the lowest coverage at 5.9 days for one presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show multiple plants on our labels received OAI classifications. Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 2618677) inspection ended 2016-10-03, 407 days before the shortage posting. Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) inspection ended 2016-06-08, 524 days before posting, and received a Warning Letter on 2017-02-14, 273 days before posting. Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 1025114) inspection ended 2016-02-26, 627 days before posting. Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 1416980) received OAI classifications from inspections ending 2024-08-01 and 2026-04-02, both after the shortage posting.

Our position: Current stock is insufficient at several sites. The best available option by rule is BE Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates purchase from BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer evaluates Civica, Inc., Gland Pharma Limited, Hepalink USA Inc., and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as secondary sources — requires P&T committee approval for each.
3. Buyer monitors daily usage at Corvale East and Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Buyer reports allocation status and lead times to P&T committee weekly — requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative anticoagulants or changing protocols; clinical decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
